low: Cash runway remains resilient under current assumptions.
Consider setting automated buffers for short-term shocks.
medium: Projected cash dips below comfort level in the stress window.
Review discretionary spend or short-term credit options.
high: Runway could shorten quickly without immediate interventions.
Prioritize liquidity planning and consider income buffers.
